sample_unit: response evaluations (10 questions x 3 responders, rated by 3 reviewers)

links.outcome: Accuracy of chatbot answers to gynecologic oncology clinical questions versus physicians
links.effect: Physicians gave accurate responses 86.7% vs ChatGPT 60% and Bard 43% (p<0.001 for both); mean quality 4.2 vs 3.0 and 2.8 out of 5.
links.quote: Physicians provided a higher proportion of accurate responses (86.7 %) compared to ChatGPT (60 %) and Bard (43 %; p < 0.001 for both).

screen.reason: Compares LLM responses to physician responses on gynecologic oncology clinical questions using blind expert grading, without evaluating a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
